singleSourced.context: The Modern Warfare 4 closed beta is currently underway, with over 115,000 concurrent players on Steam alone tuning in to check what’s new for Call of Duty.
As of this article, the beta has just over 44,000 concurrent players, while it peaked at 49,706 concurrents overall on Sunday.

singleSourced.context: "Based on what we're seeing, we need to improve." It says work to refine both spawn placements and logic is ongoing "across all maps and modes," although we'll be waiting a little longer to see whether these improvements actually make a difference.

singleSourced.key: time to kill remains a focus
singleSourced.value: time to kill remains a focus,
singleSourced.context: Additionally, the team notes that "time to kill remains a focus," along with making some underperforming attachments more viable.

All muzzles have had their pros, cons, and stats updated in the Gunsmith to "more accurately reflect functionality."

Several underbarrel attachments have also received buffs.
Additionally, the former now has less of a penalty on Sprint to Fire Speed, while the latter gains a 17% increase to Jog Speed and 50% to Strafe Speed.

singleSourced.key: making important cues easier to identify during combat while reducing sounds that overpower critical intel
singleSourced.value: making important cues easier to identify during combat while reducing sounds that overpower critical intel.
singleSourced.context: Infinity Ward continues to tweak game audio alongside this, with the goal of "making important cues easier to identify during combat while reducing sounds that overpower critical intel." There's a general remixing for the Artillery Beacon, and a volume increase for Kill Confirmed pickups, Domination point captures, the fuse on Frag Grenades, and the Attack Helicopter killstreak.

singleSourced.key: kill cams reducing the amount of gunny notifications and
singleSourced.value: kill cams, reducing the amount of Gunny notifications, and
singleSourced.context: As for what's next, Infinity Ward says it's still working on improving Hardpoint spawns on Transit 213, fixing instances of "inaccurate" kill cams, reducing the amount of Gunny notifications, and "trimming several countdowns including map voting time in order to get people into matches faster."

singleSourced.key: time to till isn t quite right yet
singleSourced.context: On top of that, Infinity Ward concurs with players that "time-to-till isn't quite right yet" and as such has "turned down the lethality of some of our guns." Oh, and map voting has been introduced, with Infinity Ward stating that the system needed four maps to work effectively—which it now has with the addition of Cachette.
Of course, Modern Warfare 4 is still in beta, which means performance is subject to change before its full release on October 23, 2026, but so far we're impressed, specifically by the lighting.
